findings.title: m9-66 apply-checkpoint.json line 35 had invalid JSON escape (raw \| on the wire)
evidence: Original line 35 had: 'gap': 'CC#5 ... regex was '^\| (m6 |m[7-9])' which ...'
The '\|' (raw bytes 0x5C 0x7C) is not a valid JSON escape sequence per RFC 8259. Python 3.14's strict parser rejects it.
Fix: promote to '\\|' (raw bytes 0x5C 0x5C 0x7C) which is a valid escape representing '\\|' as the JSON string (which when read by Python is '\|').
This was the root cause: the JSON abort on m9-66 silently broke all CCs that load it (CC#3, CC#7, CC#8, CC#11, CC#12, CC#14, CC#15, CC#22, CC#23, CC#29, CC#40, CC#43, CC#55).
